rule_definitions.minimize_waiting: Rule 1: If arrival_span == 0 -> SJF (Smith's rule optimal). Rule 2: If burst_cv >= {burst_cv_high} or burstiness >= {burstiness_high} -> SRTF (cuts head-of-line blocking). Rule 3: Else -> SJF (non-preemptive shortest job).
rule_definitions.minimize_response: Rule 1: If burst_cv >= 0.7 or priority_spread <= 1 -> RR (frequent round-robin time slicing maximizes immediate response). Rule 2: If priority_spread > 2 -> PRIORITY (prioritizes high-priority responsive jobs). Rule 3: Else -> SRTF.
rule_definitions.penalize_context_switches: Rule 1: FCFS (strictly non-preemptive with zero algorithmic preemption overhead). Rule 2: If arrival_span == 0 and burst_cv > 0.5 -> SJF (minimal switches + optimal order).
rule_definitions.balance_fairness_performance: Rule 1: If burst_cv >= 0.6 -> RR (prevents starvation of long jobs and ensures steady progress). Rule 2: Else -> SJF (high completion throughput with uniform progress).
